name: As the Saying Goes
description: Dramatization of real-life situations and stories that are related to popular sayings, by Don Tomas.

videos.title: If there were no curious ears, gossips would not exist
videos.overview: A woman is jealous when she sees that her mother loves her granddaughter very much and pays a lot of attention to her, so she does some things that she might regret.

videos.title: To have a good day, open the door
videos.overview: A young woman loses her mother. She and her sister move to her aunt's house, her pain and resentment for the loss do not let her open her heart to new experiences, but her love makes her live again.

videos.title: Everything in time and turnips in advent
videos.overview: A young man loses his mother, who reveals to him before passing away that he is adopted.

videos.title: Only the one who pinches the shoe knows where it hurts
videos.overview: Cassandra is in love with Christopher and after breaking up with him, she discovers that she is pregnant.

videos.title: He who makes good and bad choices, whatever comes don't get angry
videos.overview: A young man is thrown in prison for getting involved with the wrong people, and his parents are looking to do whatever it takes to help him.

videos.title: More is taken into account than it seems
videos.overview: Fausto works in a club and meets a mysterious young man with whom he falls in love, but this guy isn't sure about admitting his sexuality in front of others.

videos.title: Children do not hide lies, nor do they silence truths
videos.overview: Due to his illness, Guillermo must be cared for and monitored 24 hours a day, but his grandson suspects that his nurse is hiding something.

videos.title: Forgetting the injury is the best revenge
videos.overview: Yahan is reunited with his half brother, his father, and his blocked memories, while searching for the reason for his stepfather's hatred.

videos.title: You will never go to bed without learning more
videos.overview: Juan and Mónica meet after she fights with her mother, and she will look to Juan for a different kind of comfort.

videos.title: Whoever acquires a bad habit, a slave to it lives and dies
videos.overview: A young man is reunited with his mother after a long time apart and she will help him change his terrible lifestyle.

videos.title: Whoever looks at appearances, fails to know the essence
videos.overview: David, María Luisa's new partner, tries to impose her authority, but Elisa, María Luisa's daughter, is harmed, since she tries to protect herself from David.

videos.title: They are not all nightingales, those who sing among flowers
videos.overview: Mayela, from a lower class, is impressed by the lavish gifts that Alfredo gives her, including cosmetic surgery. When Mayela realizes the kind of man Alfredo is, she tries to run away from him, but Alfredo takes her prisoner.

videos.title: Fame must be earned, honor must not be lost
videos.overview: Due to a video that Kimberly recorded on social media, she begins to have many followers and thus can help her father financially.

videos.title: He who swims in sin drowns in sorrow
videos.overview: José lives with his mother and brother, with whom he does not get along, while his father lives and works in the United States. José uses the store they have in his house to resell marijuana cigarettes that he bought in high school. However, by neglecting the threat of a local leader, in a mix-up, his brother is killed outside his house.

videos.title: Any port in a storm
videos.overview: A teenage mother sells Mexican candies on the street, until one day she meets a foreign couple who offer to buy her daughter. Although she will not accept, her mother will make the worst mistake.

videos.title: When God wants to give to you, he will leave it at home
videos.overview: Dalia has to find income so she decides to rent a room in her house to Javier, a con man who will cause problems for her and her mother.
